source: Recorded from a service-role p2p-erp session, company code 1000. The kit does not import app 18; this file is the replay.

tools.name: find_supplier
tools.description: Find suppliers in the caller's company code whose name contains the given text. Results are capped and paged. count is the size of this page, not a total; a count equal to limit means another page may exist.

tools.name: get_purchase_order
tools.description: Read one purchase order in the caller's company code, including its lines. Amounts are integer minor currency units.

tools.name: get_goods_receipt
tools.description: Read the goods receipts for one purchase order in the caller's company code. Pass line_no for a single line. Results are capped and paged.

tools.name: get_invoice
tools.description: Read one invoice in the caller's company code, including its lines. Amounts are integer minor currency units.

tools.name: list_open_invoices
tools.description: List invoices in the caller's company code that are not posted or held. Results are capped and paged. count is the size of this page, not a total.

tools.name: get_payment_status
tools.description: Read an invoice's state and what has been applied to it: the applied posting, applied holds, and the applied credit total in the invoice's currency. A staged change that nobody has applied yet is not included.

structuredContent.message: no invoice visible to this principal
